heading.title: Jurisdiction of the Criminal Courts in Inquiries and Trials

article.title: Offence committed on journey or voyage
article.content: When an offence is committed whilst the person by or against whom, or the thing in respect of which, the offence is committed is in the course of performing a journey or voyage, the offence may be inquired into or tried by a Court through or into whose local jurisdiction that person or thing passed in the course of that journey or voyage.
article.html:
203Offence committed on journey or voyage

Section 203 · Chapter XIV

When an offence is committed whilst the person by or against whom, or the thing in respect of which, the offence is committed is in the course of performing a journey or voyage, the offence may be inquired into or tried by a Court through or into whose local jurisdiction that person or thing passed in the course of that journey or voyage.
